name: Forneus
source:
Number 30 of the 72 demons subjugated by Solomon, Forneus is best known for her alternate form as an enormous shark of unparalleled strength.

Having lost to Belial in the past, she travels together with her and lends considerable knowledge and expertise to the furthering of Belial's cause.

[Spoiler] After losing to Avaro and the party in an attempt to conquer the Fortress, Roseline suggests Avaro contract with her to ensure her obedience which he promptly does. The Demons of Solomon are renowned for their loyalty to masters who have bested them in combat and Forneus is no exception providing Avaro and company with the information they need to stop Belial's plan to invade and destroy the world. [/Spoiler]
